subject: Mathematics

source.topic: Numbers, operations and relationships: Mental maths (number range 10)
source.subtopic: Compare numbers to 5 (weeks 1-2), 7 (weeks 3-4), 9 (weeks 5-6) and 10 (weeks 7-10): which is more or less; recognise dot formations

show.line: Look at the dice. Five dots! You can see it without counting. Which is more, five or three?

rounds.prompt: Which is more, seven or four?
Look fast. How many dots? Say the number.
Which is less, nine or six?
Which dot card shows more dots?
Put them in order, smallest first. Three, five, seven, and then?

hints: Dice dots make a shape. Learn the shape, no counting!
On the number line, more is further along.

beat_the_tutor.setup: My turn! Which is more, eight or five?
beat_the_tutor.win_line: You caught me! Eight comes after five. Eight is more.
beat_the_tutor.gentle_line: Let's count up together. Five, six, seven, eight. Eight is more!

parent_line: Can compare numbers to 9 and spot dice dots without counting.
